text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This test covers too much. Iwas hoping to focus on training formy races too, but at this rate...
choice_data_list: Juggling classes and races must be tough.
Juggling classes and races must be tough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. As if you'd know. Your<n>workload decreases
whenever I have<n>to study for tests.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No kidding. I thought I knew what I<n>was getting
myself into when I came<n>to Tracen, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should give up on training<n>too hard during
exam season...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should give up on training<n>too hard during
exam season...
Stop right there, you prickly pear!
Stop right there, you cool cactus!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's a big no-no! Are you trying to<n>sap the color
from your world by your<n>own hand?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna let society get you<n>down and give up
on what you<n>wanna do? Take a big ol' bite outta
that kinda mentality!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are Worldwide Windy! We're the<n>whirlwind that
bites the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Do whatever you wanna do! Who<n>cares about stuff
like tests?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're too naive, Windy! A true racer<n>of the world
needs to be greedy<n>enough to achieve both!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh, sure, but I don't have that kind of<n>time...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, that's an easy fix. ♪ If<n>you can't make
more time, then just<n>train more in the time you do
have!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't confine yourself to rigid,<n>formulaic training!
Practice more<n>efficiently and boldly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In other words, you must do special<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Special training? For what?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer here will lay it all out for<n>you! ♪ Well?
What is it Dober needs<n>to catch up with the world?
choice_data_list: Th-the determination to keep chasing her dreams!
The power to overcome her nerves, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer here will lay it all out for<n>you! ♪ Well?
What is it Dober needs<n>to catch up with the world?
choice_data_list: Th-the determination to keep chasing her dreams!
The power to overcome her nerves, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Determination...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Determination's real important! I<n>have the
determination to keep pullin'<n>pranks on people no
matter how mad<n>they get at me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've got it, Dober! If you want to<n>improve your
determination...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hiking is the answer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A corner of the world we live in... In<n>other words,
the outside world!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
By hiking, you don't mean that giant<n>mountain in
the distance, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I certainly do. ♪ If you seek the<n>summit in life, then
you must first<n>reach the summit of a mountain!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Is that really how it<n>works?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... This is so hard...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No complaining, girl! We're aiming for<n>the summit,
aka your dream of<n>reaching stardom in the racing
world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can you make it?! Surely you can get<n>to the new
world without stopping!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I know all that, but must I do it while<n>pulling my
trainer on a sled?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The extra weight isn't bothering me,<n>but it's so
difficult to keep my<n>balance while walking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't need your encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You made it! You've reached the<n>summit! This is a
special stage only<n>those with true determination can
reach!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You made it! You've reached the<n>summit! This is a
special stage only<n>those with true determination can
reach!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, unleash your passion! Shout out<n>your dream
with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My dream... I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to become strong enough to<n>compete against
Air Groove and the<n>rest of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh! You were so cool just now,<n>even the world
acknowledges you for<n>who you are!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That wasn't half bad! I'll give you<n>that much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A-all I could think about was putting<n>one foot in
front of the other...
choice_data_list: You look stronger than you did before the hike.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Q-quit making fun of me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Trainer! Stop trying to<n>embarrass me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I guess that did help toughen me<n>up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I guess that did help toughen me<n>up...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Later, possibly thanks to her special<n>training,
Mejiro Dober does well both<n>on her exams and in
her training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The power to overcome my nerves...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That tracks! I can't pull off any<n>pranks if I'm too
nervous 'bout<n>things!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have a plan! Now, then...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's scale a cliff!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because there's no training more<n>suited to
conquering the hurdle<n>known as anxiety!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Er... So you're saying that this cliff is<n>my anxiety?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! I couldn't have asked for a<n>more perfect
and sophisticated<n>answer! ♪ A new world awaits
you<n>beyond that wall!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I don't know about that...
choice_data_list:
I'll climb it with you! I want to overcome this
together!

I'll climb it with you! I want to overcome this
together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding me?! There's no<n>reason for you to
climb it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Don't be ridiculous! You might get<n>hurt if you try!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Waiting is part of your job! Use that<n>path over there
to get to the top<n>instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me. Use that path<n>and wait for
me at the end... just like<n>you always do for me at
my races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Urgh! This is just as tough as I<n>thought...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Urgh! This is just as tough as I<n>thought...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The flowing breeze, the smell of the<n>earth... Whew! I
can feel the pulse of<n>the world! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're slowing down, girl! This can't<n>be the extent
of your willpower, can<n>it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course not!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(If I can climb this cliff, it'll prove how<n>strong I've
become, and I won't<n>have to be scared of
anything!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well... Yeah, I did.
choice_data_list: It looks like you had fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... For some reason, it felt<n>like I was in a
race.
choice_data_list: It looks like you had fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: As if...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I do feel stronger now, so I<n>suppose that
wasn't a total waste of<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was a reckless climb, but I'm<n>feeling better now,
and I think I'm<n>stronger too...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Looks like you've broken<n>through another
one of your shells<n>and made it to a new world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Looks like you've broken<n>through another
one of your shells<n>and made it to a new world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You should be grateful to us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I had no idea what was going<n>on the whole
time... but this really did<n>make me tougher.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you both. And... I guess you<n>too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you both. And... Trainer, thank<n>you to you too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Later, possibly thanks to her special<n>training,
Mejiro Dober does well both<n>on her exams and in
her training.

Later, possibly thanks to her special<n>training,
